turn_text: This podcast is brought to you by the Association for Diplomatic Studies and Training, ADST. For more, check out our website at ADST.org. ADST, American Diplomacy, Wortzenall. Walter Mondale was the 42nd Vice President of the United States under Jimmy Carter, after having served 12 years as a Senator from Minnesota. In this interview, he talks about his long career in the U.S. government, his time in the Senate, his tenure as Vice President, including his dealings with South Africa, China, and the Iran crisis, and his frustrations and insights from his years as Ambassador to Japan. First, he talks about his changing views of the Vietnam War.
